day_local: NgoLwesine weVeki yeShumi elinesithathu ngexesha eliqhelekileyo
greeting: Egameni likaYise, nelikaNyana, nelikaMoya oyiNgcwele. Makube noxolo lwenkosi nani nonke.
penitential: Nkosi, usivele inceba. Kristu, usivele inceba. Nkosi, usivele inceba.
psalm_response: IMvana isenze ubukumkani bababingeleli bokukhonza uThixo wethu.
homily:
Cinga ngomzuzu apho ubona umntwana, umfana osakhulayo, ehleli phantsi kwesibhakabhaka esikhulu, ejonge phezulu ngamehlo agcwele ukumangaliswa. UBenjamin Vo wayenalo olo hlobo lwembono. Wayengumfana owayethanda iinqwelo-moya, owayecinga nge-'con chim airlines' yakhe ngoncumo olungazenzisiyo, owayebona ihlabathi njengendawo ebanzi, ezele ngamathuba okufunda nokwakha. KwiNcwadi yeSityhilelo namhlanje, uYohane usimema ukuba sijonge phezulu, kodwa hayi nje esibhakabhakeni esiluhlaza, kodwa kwisango elivulekileyo lasezulwini. 'Ndiye ndabona umnyango ovulekileyo ezulwini,' utsho uYohane. Masiyimele kancinci le ndinyana… Umnyango ovulekileyo. Asiludonga oluvaliweyo, asiluphelo lwendlela, kodwa sisimemo sokungena kwi-Banquet yasezulwini apho uBen ngoku aphumla khona.

KwiVangeli yanamhlanje, uYesu uyalila. 'As Jesus drew near Jerusalem, he saw the city and wept over it.' Masiyimele kancinci le ndinyana… uYesu uyalila. Akalili nje ngenxa yezinto eziza kwenzeka, kodwa ulila ngenxa yokuba abantu abazange bayibone 'ixesha lokundwendwelwa' kwabo. UYesu ufuna ukuba sibe noxolo, ufuna ukuba sibone ukuba uThixo ukhona ecaleni kwethu, nokuba iintlungu zinkulu kangakanani. UBen wayeyiqonda le nto. Wayeyiqonda indlela yokufumana uvuyo kwizinto ezincinci, njengaxa wayechitha ixesha nobawo wakhe 'espotta' iinqwelo-moya, okanye xa wayecinga nge-'con chim airlines' yakhe. Wayengumfana owayenentliziyo evulekileyo, intliziyo eyayikwazi ukubona ubuhle nokuba ihlabathi lalinzima.

Alan noThao, ndiyazi ukuba kule minyane mihlanu idlulileyo ukususela ngowe-13 kuJuni 2026, iintlungu ziza ngamanye amaxesha ngendlela embi kakhulu. Kukho amaxesha apho ukungabikho kukaBen kwenza ikhaya libe ngenye indlela. Mamele kakuhle: uThixo akakubeki icala. UBen akakubeki icala. Ezo zifo aziziswanga zizinto owazenzayo okanye ongazenzanga. Kweli hlabathi, kukho izinto ezenzeka ngaphandle kolawulo lomntu, ngaphandle kwempazamo yomzali. Awuphosanga nto. Uthando lwakho lwalucocekile, lwaluphelele, kwaye uBen wayesazi ukuba unothando olungaka kubazali bakhe nakuRyan. Khipha elo litye lokuzisola ezintliziyweni zenu namhlanje. UBen akajongi iziphoso; ujonge phezulu kuThixo, kwaye uqhubeka esithi kuwe: 'Ba, Mama, musani ukukhala kakhulu, ndikhuselekile.'

Khumbula indlela uBen awayenentliziyo evulekileyo ngayo. Khumbula loo mzuzu xa wayefuna ukunikela ngayo yonke imali yakhe yasebhange ukuze ancede umalume wakhe uWilliam. Wayengazange ayiphule loo ngulube, kodwa isipho sasingaphakathi entliziyweni yakhe. Le yimfihlelo yobomi: asikokuba unika malini, kodwa ukuba intliziyo yakho ikulungele na ukunika. UBen wayeyiqonda le nto. Wayengumfana owayethanda ukwabelana, owayethanda ukuhleka xa ethetha nge-'con chim airlines' yakhe, owayethanda ukuba noRyan ecaleni kwakhe. Uthando lwakhe lwalungapheliyo, kwaye lusaqhubeka lukhanya nangoku. UBen wayengumfana owayenengqondo enkulu yezibalo nolwazi, kodwa ikratshi lakhe elikhulu kwakuwukuba ngumntwana omhle owayehlonipha abazali bakhe.

Ryan, mfowethu okhoyo apha, ndifuna uthathe oku nawe. UBen akakushiye. Ukhona ecaleni kwakho, eqhubeka ekusebenza njengesikhokelo sothando. UBen uya kuhlala ekukhuthaza, nangona ungamboni ngamehlo, kodwa uya kumva entliziyweni yakho. Uthando lwenu njengabazalwana luyinto engunaphakade. Xa uziva usodwa, khumbula ukuba uBen ukhona, uyaqhubeka, kwaye uya kuhlala ephila kuthando lukaThixo olungapheliyo. UBen akakho nje kwimbali yenu; ukwikhona apho uThixo enza khona yonke into ibe ntsha.

Masithathe oku namhlanje: uBen wasishiya isipho sothando olungapheliyo. Kwisikhumbuzo sesidlo sasezulwini, lapho indlu kaThixo izele khona ngabantu abavela kude nakufi, masime nathi namhlanje siqinisekile ukuba ubomi bukaBen abuphelanga ethuneni. Usemthekweni wasezulwini, apho i-'con chim airlines' yakhe ibhabha ngokuphakamileyo phambi kobuso bukaThixo. Hamba ke namhlanje uphumle, uthembe ukuba uThixo uyakuthanda, kwaye uBen ulinda wena ngoncumo lwakhe oluqhelekileyo. Uthando lwakho, Ben, lusaqhubeka luhamba emhlabeni, lusaqhubeka lukhanya, kwaye lusaqhubeka lukhumbuza wonke umntu okwaziyo ukuba uThixo uyamthanda umntwana wakhe ngaphezu kwayo yonke into. Hlalani neli themba. Hlalani nolu thando. UBen ukhona, uyaqhubeka, kwaye uya kuhlala ephila kuthando lukaThixo olungapheliyo. Amen.
spiritual_communion: Nkosi yam, Yesu Kristu, ndikholelwa ukuba ukhona ngenene kwiSakramente eNgcwele. Ndikuthanda ngaphezu kwayo yonke into, kwaye ndinqwena ukukwamkela emphefumlweni wam. Njengoko ndingenakukwamkela ngoku kwiSakramente, nceda uze emphefumlweni wam ngomoya. Ndikwamkela njengokungathi uze ngokwenene, kwaye ndizimanyanisa nawe ngokupheleleyo. Ungaze undivumele ndahluke kuwe. Amen.
closing: Ngamana uThixo onamandla onke angakusikelela, akuphathe ngoxolo, kwaye akugcine eluthandweni lwakhe olungapheliyo. Hamba ngoxolo.
standing_petitions: Sithandazela umphefumlo kaBen kunye nabo bonke abasishiyileyo, ukuze baphumle ekukhanyeni kukaKristu ngonaphakade.
Sithandazela bonke abakhathazekileyo ngenxa yokulahlekelwa, ukuze uThixo abathuthuzele kwaye abanike ithemba eliqinileyo.

readings.label: Isifundo sokuqala
readings.text: Mna, Yohane, ndabona umqulu esandleni sokunene salowo uhleli etroneni. Wawunemibhalo macala omabini, utywinwe ngetywina elisixhenxe. Ndabona ingelosi enamandla imemezela ngelizwi elikhulu, 'Ngubani ofanelekileyo ukuwuvula umqulu nokwaphula itywina lawo?' Kodwa akubangakho mntu ezulwini, nasemhlabeni, naphantsi komhlaba owakwazi ukuwuvula umqulu okanye ukuwuhlola. Ndakhala iinyembezi ezininzi kuba kungekho mntu wafunyanwa efanelekileyo ukuwuvula umqulu okanye ukuwuhlola. Omnye wabadala wathi kum, 'Ungakhali. Ingonyama yesizwe sakwaYuda, ingcambu kaDavide, yoyisile, imenza akwazi ukuwuvula umqulu netywina lawo elisixhenxe.' Ndabona phakathi kwetrone nezidalwa ezine eziphilayo nabadala, iMvana ebonakala ngathi ixheliwe. Yayinezimpondo ezisixhenxe namehlo asixhenxe; le yimimoya esixhenxe kaThixo ethunyelwe ehlabathini lonke. Yeza yamkela umqulu esandleni sokunene salowo uhleli etroneni. Xa yawuthabathayo, izidalwa ezine eziphilayo nabadala abangamashumi amabini anesine bawa phantsi phambi kweMvana. Ngamnye wabadala wayephethe uhadi neendebe zegolide ezigcwele isiqhumiso, ezingumthandazo wabangcwele. Bacula ingoma entsha: 'Ufanelekile wena ukwamkela umqulu nokwaphula itywina lawo, kuba waxheliwa, kwaye ngeGazi lakho wathengela uThixo abo baphuma kuzo zonke izizwe, neelwimi, nabantu, nezizwe. Ubenze ubukumkani bababingeleli kuThixo wethu, kwaye baya kulawula emhlabeni.'

readings.label: INdumiso
readings.text: R. IMvana isenze ubukumkani bababingeleli bokukhonza uThixo wethu. Culela iNkosi ingoma entsha, yodumo kwibandla labathembekileyo. Makavuye uSirayeli kuMenzi wakhe, abantwana baseZiyon mabavuye eKumkanini wabo. R. IMvana isenze ubukumkani bababingeleli bokukhonza uThixo wethu. Mabayidumise igama layo ngomdaniso womthendeleko, mabayiculele iindumiso ngohadi nangohadi. Kuba iNkosi iyabathanda abantu bayo, kwaye ihombisa abathobekileyo ngoloyiso. R. IMvana isenze ubukumkani bababingeleli bokukhonza uThixo wethu. Mabavuya abathembekileyo eludumweni; mabayiculele iindumiso ngovuyo ezindongweni zabo; iindumiso eziphakamileyo zikaThixo mazibe semqaleni yabo. Olu luludumo lwabo bonke abathembekileyo bayo. Alleluia. R. IMvana isenze ubukumkani bababingeleli bokukhonza uThixo wethu.

readings.label: IVangeli
readings.text: Njengoko uYesu wayesondela eJerusalem, wawubona umzi waza wawulilela, esithi, 'Ukuba ubukwazi ngale mini okuzisa uxolo—kodwa ngoku kufihliwe emehlweni akho. Kuba iintsuku ziyeza phezu kwakho apho iintshaba zakho ziya kwakha uthango olujikeleze wena; ziya kukungqonga zikucinele macala onke. Ziya kukubetha emhlabeni kunye nabantwana bakho abaphakathi kwakho, kwaye aziyi kushiya ilitye phezu kwelitye ngaphakathi kuwe kuba awuzange uliqonde ixesha lokundwendwelwa kwakho.'

day: Thursday of the Thirty-third Week in Ordinary Time

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: I miss you so much Ben! Ba má nhớ con rất nhiều mỗi ngày.
Nha Trang, ngày 31/10/2026, anh Minh suy nghĩ về Ben rất nhiều. Nhớ và thương em!!!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben - mom and I have been missing you a lot.   Saw you a few times in my dreams last few weeks! Come and say hi daily okay?
Thinking of you buddy! Stop by to say hello whenever you can okay? Love you Ben

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben - Been dreaming about you a lot. Hope you're having fun up in heaven. Please look after our family. Remember to come say hi daily. We miss you so much!

Ben ơi, trong giấc ngủ anh Huy đã thấy Ben về thăm anh, trao cho anh lời cầu nguyện để hai anh em mình lại được tìm thấy nhau. Xin Chúa thương nhậm lời Ben, cho Ben được hưởng ngàn thu bình an bên Chúa. Nếu có thể, xin Ben lại ghé thăm anh trong những giấc mơ tiếp theo nhé, dù chỉ là một lời chào hay một nụ cười thân thương như ngày nào.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Ben, my sweet boy, I miss you so much. Thank you for visiting me and Chú Chris last night. He told me he saw you flying a helicopter—so free, joyful, and strong up there. Down here, Mom and I are crying more and more each day. A piece of my heart feels completely dead without you, Ben. Please watch over us, pray for your mom, your brother Ryan, and me, and give us the strength to keep going. We love you forever
